errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents LLM model names, including “3B unk”, “405B”, “1.5B”, “unk”, “671B”, “7B,” “Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct”, “Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct,” “GPT-4o”, “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B”, “o1-preview”, and “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the x-axis tick labels (e.g., "3B", "unk") with the bar categories found in the legend (e.g., "Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct"), stating they are all on the horizontal axis. The legend entries define the bars themselves, not the axis labels.

errors.text_span: The vertical axis is labeled with a numeric scale from 0 to 100, incrementing by 10
errors.evidence: The vertical axis properties are not consistent across all plots. Plots (a), (b), and (c) have y-axes that start above 0 (e.g., 65 or 80) and have tick increments of 5. Plots (d), (e), and (f) have a range of 0 to 90 with increments of 10.

errors.text_span: Each group displays a set of stacked bars representing the contributions of separate components to the overall score
errors.evidence: The charts contain simple, side-by-side bars within each subplot, not stacked bars. This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the chart's structure.

errors.text_span: each identified by a distinct color and a corresponding label: blue for “TTS”, gray for "CoT", pink for “Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct”
errors.evidence: The color-to-label mapping is incorrect. According to the legend, blue represents "Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct", not "TTS". Gray represents "o1", not "CoT". Pink represents "o1-mini", not "Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct". Furthermore, "TTS" and "CoT" are represented by fill patterns (hatched and solid, respectively), not colors.

errors.text_span: Within each group, the bars for the various components are stacked vertically
errors.evidence: This statement reinforces the incorrect claim that the bars are stacked. The bars in each subplot are arranged side-by-side.

errors.text_span: for example, in group (a), the "TTS" component, depicted in blue, has an approximate value of 78.2, while the "CoT" component represented in gray has a value of 95.
errors.evidence: This example is entirely incorrect. It misidentifies the blue bar as "TTS" (it's "Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct"). It hallucinates a "CoT" component as a gray bar in group (a), which does not exist. The value 95 is from a bar in group (c), not group (a).

errors.text_span: The bars are sorted alphabetically within each group
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted alphabetically in any of the groups, either by their model name from the legend or by their x-axis label.

errors.text_span: denoted by a small icon, such as a circle, triangle, or square
errors.evidence: The icons on the bars are not generic geometric shapes; they are specific company logos for Meta, OpenAI, and DeepSeek.

The description completely omits the meaning of the two fill patterns shown in the legend and on the bars: solid fill for the "CoT" method and hatched fill for the "TTS" method. This is a critical piece of information for understanding the chart.
